g.text: Top: recorded human 95% group-bootstrap interval (shading); prediction bars = ±1.96 Monte Carlo SE, shown separately.

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; fill: #b6c6df

g.text: Bottom: paired 95% intervals from the same 2,000 human-group bootstrap resamples, stratified by rule; forecasts held fixed.

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; fill: #b6c6df

g.text: BC1, FA-best and its CL variant are primary. Task 03 GRU and constant are named secondary references.
